reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 in /hack/api-docs by @dependabot in https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4647", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The bump is confined to the /hack/api-docs developer tooling; the evidence states no effect on deployed external-secrets components, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational change.

proposed.statement: The 0.16.0 release bumps the urllib3 dependency used by the /hack/api-docs developer tooling from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0.
